description: Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council - Appropriation (amendment) Statute No. 10 of 2017 of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to the amendment of an appropriation statute (Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 10 of 2017) for the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council. It involves the modification of legal financial limits and accounts within an existing legal framework. This falls under the "Legal/Regulatory" classification as it deals with statutory instruments and amendments to existing legislation.
